title: City Cruises Philadelphia: Brunch Cruise on the Delaware River
includes: Unlimited coffee, hot tea, iced tea and water
Delicious brunch buffet with freshly prepared entrees, salads and desserts
A two-hour cruise on the Delaware River
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
Infants aged 2 years and under are free of charge (meal not included).
Seating is only guaranteed together for the number of tickets confirmed on this voucher. Reservations may not be combined.
Dress code: We encourage casual attire that is informal and comfortable, (khakis, nice jeans, dresses, casual button-ups/blouses) for your day on the water.

Our experience may offer Vegan, Vegatarian, and Gluten free options. Before placing your order, please inform your server if a person in your party has a food allergy. Consuming raw or undercooked meats, poultry, seafood, shellfish or eggs may increase our risk of food-borne illness, especially if you have a medical condition. Menus subject to change.
Boarding begins 30 minutes prior to departure. Guests must arrive early, as late arrivals will likely miss the boat.
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Our Philadelphia Signature Brunch Cruise is an unforgettable experience. Dine and dance on the Delaware River with views of the city’s magnificent skyline on this casual afternoon out. Enjoy a delicious, chef-prepared buffet and gorgeous views of Philadelphia’s spectacular architecture. You’ll marvel at famed city landmarks, such as the Ben Franklin Bridge, from our cozy, climate-controlled interior, and open-air roof decks. We keep the spirits flowing with a fully stocked bar, games, and lively music from our DJ. Join us for a memorable, one-of-a-kind brunch cruise on the water
